checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the legs and feet are cropped out of the frame, marking them as 'is_testable: false'. This is accurate; we cannot penalize the model for missing anatomy that is not visible. The Router also correctly flagged the lack of vivid iridescence (green/blue/purple) on the plumage, as the bird is primarily white with black markings. I agree with all checkpoint verdicts. The image passes all testable checkpoints related to the visible head and upper body.
artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly in the neck feathers (severity 1.5) and a structural collapse at the beak-wattle junction (severity 2.0). Visual inspection confirms the beak-wattle junction is indeed muddy and lacks distinct anatomical boundaries, validating the Router's finding. Additionally, the Perceptual Quality Auditor detected 'slight compression' (score 0.2), which manifests as minor blockiness in the background foliage and feather edges. While the SAM mask confidence is high (0.99), indicating good overall silhouette integrity, the internal textural details show signs of generative smoothing and compression artifacts. I will adjust the artifact score slightly to account for the confirmed compression alongside the anatomical fusion.
alignment_reasoning: All visible checkpoints (Head/Face, Body/Plumage, Tail) are passed. Legs/Feet are correctly marked N/A due to cropping. Expert classifier confirms 'cock' with high confidence. Minor deduction only for the specific color variation (white vs iridescent) which is a breed difference but technically a deviation from the generic 'vivid/metallic' description.
